what: The verdict each Rule line and scenario of tdf/features/tdf.feature is expected to get (plan node T9.7a). Written and committed BEFORE the feature file was compiled and before any proof of it was attempted. Compared with the verdicts of an overlay run by `python3 -m clausal overlay run tdf` (run from clausal/; it exits 1 on a difference). FIX ROUND (after review): the items g3_all_of_decision, g3_any_of_decision, g3_hierarchy_decision, g3_all_of_unscoped, g5_entitled_declared_released and g5_release_required_declared were added, and every item got `link` where tdf/links.yaml links it; no code of an item of the first freeze was changed. Committed with tdf/links.yaml before the new Lean meanings were built, before any link was proved and before the run.

codes.PROVED-FOR-ALL: the line compiles; the compiled reading is kernel-checked equivalent to its generated flat obligation; a theorem of exactly that obligation exists with standard axioms only, and its proof is from the theorems of T9.3 (private/tdf-core/core-lean/T93); the scope of the reading is met at a named input. FIX ROUND: with `link`, the sentence is one of the sentences of that link of tdf/links.yaml, the link is proved and counted (exact type, standard axioms, no proof of either side, no T9.3 theorem outside its `given`), and the theorem of the obligation is the one the run derives from the link and the T9.3 theorems; if the link is not counted the verdict is UNLINKED. Without `link` the sentence is ONE-WAY (it follows from the theorems of T9.3; nothing shows it says as much). Every theorem listed under `through` must be reached by the proof, or the verdict is STATED-ONLY
codes.PROVED-INSTANCE: the same for a scenario about one named policy and one named request
codes.REFUTED: the line compiles; a theorem of exactly `¬ reading` exists with standard axioms only, proved at a named input. FIX ROUND: with `link` (a negated link), also: the sentence is false exactly when the linked T9.3 statement holds; UNLINKED if that link is not counted
codes.UNBOUND: the line is not a composition of today's pieces: no statement
codes.UNLINKED: the reading is not kernel-linked to what its proof is about: reading ↔ obligation failed, or (fix round) the item has `link` and that link to the T9.3 statements is not counted
codes.STATED-ONLY: the line compiles and is linked; no counted proof (none, or not of the exact type, or other axioms, or its scope is not shown to be met, or (fix round) it does not reach a theorem listed under `through`)

a policy with one anyOf attribute
